name: Azman bin Hassan
bio:
Azman's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After spending his youth tinkering with motorcycles in his village, he landed an apprenticeship at a local auto body shop. His meticulous attention to detail and knack for color matching quickly set him apart. A chance encounter with a visiting race team needing emergency bodywork repairs opened the door to the world of professional racing. 

He joined Cadillac Racing a decade ago, and has become a vital part of the team. He oversees all paint and bodywork, ensuring the cars look their best on the track. Azman prides himself on his problem-solving skills and his ability to maintain composure under pressure. His extensive experience allows him to quickly assess damage, formulate a plan, and execute repairs with minimal downtime, a trait his teammates greatly appreciate. He is known for his innovative use of specialized painting techniques that improve aerodynamics.

physical.description: Azman is a lean man with a permanent squint from years of examining paint finishes.

quirks: Always hums traditional Malaysian folk songs while working.
Insists on using a specific brand of imported Japanese sandpaper.
Carries a small, worn photo of his family in his toolbox, said to bring good luck.
